topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I always thought I knew him, could read him like the worn pages of an old book. But the words we spoke today, they unfurled a new chapter, one where the letters wove a story I never suspected. He was not the man at the helm of his bustling enterprise, a captain of industry commanding the tides of fortune. Instead, he was adrift, casting nets into waters far less vast. The revelation, it didn’t sink me in sorrow or rage; it widened my eyes to the shores of his true world. In that moment, I glimpsed the depths of our bond, stronger perhaps for the truths we now hold, unhidden, between us.
